Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Account Manager position at PwC Belgium. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I have developed a strong foundation in managing marketing initiatives from concept to execution. At Episto, I own on-page SEO and content strategies for client websites, and I have built and maintained WordPress sites, ensuring alignment with business goals. My project mirook.com showcases my ability to design, optimize, and report on marketing performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. I am eager to bring my project management skills and client-focused approach to PwC, where I can contribute to impactful campaigns and grow within a dynamic team. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am committed to further improving my Dutch. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your marketing efforts.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Account Manager role at PwC Belgium. Your emphasis on end-to-end campaign ownership and stakeholder collaboration resonates with my experience in digital marketing and project coordination. At Episto, I manage SEO and content initiatives for multiple client websites, from keyword research to publishing and performance reporting. This involves close collaboration with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions that drive organic growth. Additionally, I built and optimized mirook.com, a WordPress site for a youth chess champion, where I implemented technical SEO, structured data, and social media integration, resulting in improved search visibility. These experiences have honed my ability to manage projects, prioritize tasks, and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

I am particularly drawn to PwC's commitment to lifelong learning and inclusive culture. I am eager to apply my skills in campaign management, content creation, and analytics to support your service offerings. While my Dutch is currently at B1 level, I am actively taking classes to improve, and I am confident in my ability to work effectively in English and collaborate in a multilingual environment. My background in front-end development and CRM basics further enables me to quickly adapt to new tools and contribute to integrated marketing efforts.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my proactive approach and attention to detail can benefit your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
